Name: Ness from Earthbound replacing Vincent
Author: SynthwaveKnight
Description:
[size=3]Changes Vincent into Ness, the main character from Earthbound/Mother 2. Other than the sprites the name is also changed everywhere so you won't see Vincent still in dialogues, in the menu and similar. Certain lines were also changed (for example Vincent hunting for bugs is now Ness hunting for hamburgers in trash cans). [/size]

[size=4]Requirements:[/size]
[size=3]- [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[size=3]- [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=3]Content Patcher[/size]

[/url][size=3]To install manually simply drop the [CP] Ness folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder, after getting the required things. To remove the mod, remove the Ness folder from your Stardew Valley mods folder.﻿
